name: O-UCF / O-JHMDB / OVIS-UCF / OVIS-JHMDB / Real-OUCF
description: This paper explores the impact of occlusions in video action detection. We facilitate this study by introducing five new benchmark datasets namely O-UCF and O-JHMDB consisting of synthetically controlled static/dynamic occlusions, OVIS-UCF and OVIS-JHMDB consisting of occlusions with realistic motions and Real-OUCF for occlusions in realistic-world scenarios. We formally confirm an intuitive expectation: existing models suffer a lot as occlusion severity is increased and exhibit different behaviours when occluders are static vs when they are moving. evaluation_method: detection mAP under varying occlusion severity
reputation: A recent specialized benchmark suite that is useful for studying occlusion robustness in video action detection, but it is not yet a widely standardized benchmark.
notes: Benchmark is focused on robustness under synthetic and realistic occlusions rather than broad dataset saturation; performance varies strongly with occlusion severity and occluder motion.
